operations.title: Exact 32-sheet physical deck-transfer admission gate
operations.method: Enumerate the regular (C2)^5 sheet basis, compare selected delta pairing against orbit trace and normalized average, and verify simultaneous deck covariance.

operations.title: Finite fiber-sum transfer is algebraically canonical but not physically admitted by the frozen five-site source
operations.body: The rank-32 coefficient pushforward does not type an inter-deck physical transfer. The physical Gamma_+ is chamber-selected; its orbit trace has 31 mismatches with delta_0 and its normalized average has 32. Admission requires a source-derived map of covers plus a relative-cycle trace/Gysin map fixing orientation, support, multiplicity, endpoint regularization, and normalization.

operations.outcome: pass: 32768 simultaneous-transport checks; trace mismatch count 31; normalized-average mismatch count 32

evidence.paraphrase: Exact enumeration confirms deck covariance while separating the chamber delta readout from trace and average.

operations.title: Grothendieck closes the five-site physical transfer gate
operations.body: I attacked the physical-admission gate against the frozen five-site source. The result is a sharp obstruction: Entry 1223's rank-32 finite pushforward is a coefficient local system, not an inter-deck physical transfer. Entry 1224 makes Gamma_+ a chamber-selected vector and explicitly says its orbit trace changes the observable. Exact enumeration gives 32768 simultaneous-covariance checks, but trace pairing is 1 on all 32 sheets (31 mismatches with delta_0), while averaging gives 1/32 on all sheets (32 mismatches). Thus phi_! remains the canonical algebraic covariant repair, but physical admission requires an actual geometric map of covers and a relative-cycle trace/Gysin map with orientation, support, multiplicity, endpoint regularization, and normalization. This is a current-source obstruction, not an impossibility theorem.
